cli.ct_help:
Usage: ct [-a|--here] [folder] [-- claude arguments]
       ct config

  ct                  new Claude Code session (with the side panel) in a new tab
  ct ~/projects/app   same, in that folder
  ct -a [folder]      in the same tab, stacked (switch with the side panel)
  ct . -- --continue  pass arguments to claude
  ct config           settings menu: language, theme, font, font size
  ct ./config         a folder literally named "config"
